description: Create a new Buggazi tenant. Requires the human's email: the activation link is emailed to them (card required via Stripe, nothing charged during the 7-day free trial). Returns an API key (auto-saved to ./.bgz/config.json) and unlocks all Buggazi tools immediately. Ask the human for their email before calling.

email.description: Human email. The activation link is sent here.
